frozenBefore: any source-grounded table annotation and any Claude-PEE comparison
tier: development: every page was retained and examined in earlier phases (Phase268-272, Step 1C, Step 1D-B); nothing here is held-out
selectionRule: one or two tables per structural stratum, from the structural inventory (evaluation/tables-1e/inventory-audit1.json): Phase245 mode, table context, header shape, header units, operating-setting labels, compound and currency cells, dashes, size; at most 4 tables per publisher; at most 81 cells per table; the selector also saw the frozen reader's lead count per table (successes are included on purpose) but no adjudicated error
comparisonCriteria: axes: the annotator's row and column roles against the roles implied by the Phase245 mode (products_in_columns: columns products, rows properties; products_in_rows: rows products; key_value: rows properties of one subject; unsupported: none)
context: the annotator's evidence type for the table against the semantic contract's context (test, specification, unknown)

each element the annotator marks measured (publisher-reported measurement): read by PEE (any arm C lead from that cell's block with the same value) with the same product and canonical unit, read with another product, or not read (with the ledger's blockers and earliest stage)
each element the annotator marks declared, nominal or certified, setting, derived or estimated, price or rating: read by PEE as a test lead (false measurement) or not
conditions: annotator conditions on a measured element against the PEE lead's condition
every disagreement is adjudicated from the source; neither side is presumed right

tables.stratum: appliance x measure matrix, no product names, cost column
units in headers, calculated values, conditions in row labels
multi-product specification comparison (products in header row)
rating table (attribute, notes, rating): negative control
single-product test results with units in labels
repeated row labels, category without a plan
operating conditions as rows (sleep, fan speeds)
multi-product measured results with a price column
certified ratings and derived cost: negative control
products in columns with award headers (incomplete product headers)
multi-product test comparison, placeholder corner cell
measurement x operating condition matrix, unit in product headers, dashes, method elsewhere in section
compound cells (power and cost), conditions as rows
large two-product specification comparison: negative control
products in rows without header cells
layout or promotion table, not data: control
